amendments.scope: Issue 1034 populated forum, dedicated route and Ajax, and RecentThreads needs-source rows

ordering_rules: Apply site, actor, group, category, deletion, and page-view authority before sorting, counts, limits, or pagination.
Use database writes only to arrange test fixtures. Prove acceptance through public preview, saved-page, action, or browser output.
Keep unsupported module heads, argument shapes, Ajax modules, and mutation events fail closed.
Do not treat page-discussion thread provisioning as authority to create a forum post or a standalone forum thread.
method.source_change_disposition: The original lane established the forum-mini behavior and public case bindings. This amendment implements only the newly observed current RecentThreads placeholder contract. It also seals anonymous read-only FrontForum, Comments, forum route, and Ajax evidence, but leaves those broader production slices actionable because the evidence does not define their full selection, actor, browser lifecycle, or mutation contracts.

evidence.authority: Anonymous live PagePreview and saved public workbench observations for MiniRecentThreads, MiniActiveThreads, and MiniRecentPosts.
Twenty-four anonymous live PagePreview inputs and raw outputs with fixed source and output hashes.
Frozen anonymous own-line module outputs for Comments, FrontForum, ForumCategory, ForumNewThread, ForumStart, ForumThread, RecentPosts, and the site-specific RecentThreads observation.
Anonymous PagePreview, served GET, and read-only Ajax observations for the exact current RecentThreads placeholder and nonterminal FrontForum, Comments, category, thread, and recent-post surfaces.

mutation_boundary_audit.page_discussion_create_is_not_post_autho: wikidot_page_discussion_create checks page visibility and discussion settings, then provisions one empty page-discussion thread with locking and idempotency. It does not create, edit, or delete a forum post, and it does not create a standalone ForumNewThread thread.
mutation_boundary_audit.request_csrf_boundary: Framerail enables SvelteKit origin checking outside the local environment. The Ajax handler accepts wikidot_token7 as a control field but does not validate it for forum actions.
mutation_boundary_audit.decision: Do not connect Comments, ForumNewThread, ForumThread, or RecentPosts mutation controls. No public endpoint currently combines a request actor, forum permission, mutation domain rule, and action-specific CSRF or rate-limit policy.

source_ready.result: The public preview test now names every sealed input. It covers the default limit, positive limit, zero, negative, text, unknown argument, inline owner, and raw owner for all three modules.
The saved-page seam removes hidden groups and page discussions that the anonymous actor cannot view before it applies each module limit.

The public saved-page test covers recent and active thread order, routes, dates, reply counts, recent reply order, page and forum anchors, plain excerpts, printuser output, and standalone root exclusion.

candidate_required.requires: Run the public preview test and sealed 24-case differential against the exact merged candidate. Bind the receipt to source, FTML, lock, fixture, and runtime identities.

Run MiniRecentThreads, MiniActiveThreads, and MiniRecentPosts through saved page_view on the exact candidate. Prove order, limits, routes, identities, and permission filtering from the public response.
Verify forum and comments anchors, printuser interaction, date settling, failed requests, and initial and settled output on the exact candidate.

blocked_evidence.missing: No sealed anonymous, member, moderator, administrator, private, hidden, and deleted transition matrix exists.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not infer actor visibility from the anonymous fixture or apply filtering after a row limit.

blocked_evidence.missing: Live evidence does not define rich-markup reduction, missing-title text, exact truncation, timestamp ties, or activity ties.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not turn the current plain 160-character helper into a claimed Wikidot-wide excerpt contract.

blocked_evidence.missing: No sealed create, edit, delete, restore, cache, and concurrent-read sequence exists, and no public authorized forum-post mutation endpoint exists.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not use internal fixture service calls as acceptance proof or expose them as public mutation authority.

source_ready.result: Public PagePreview covers the exact observed no-context output for Comments, FrontForum, ForumCategory, ForumNewThread, and ForumThread. It also preserves inline and raw owners and leaves unobserved FrontForum arguments fail closed.

Public PagePreview covers visible group and category order, empty category rows, exact table DOM, escaped text, and last-post data. It removes hidden groups and private page discussions before category thread and post counts.

Public preview and saved page_view cover empty and populated output, exact post DOM, routes, compiled content, newest-first order, and two pages. Hidden groups and private page discussions are removed before ordering, counts, and pagination.

public_tests: framerail/tests/ajax-module-connector.test.js#fails closed for unsupported modules and duplicate fields
source_ready.result: Framerail returns a stable not_ok envelope for forum/ForumStartModule instead of routing the request to ListPages or a mutation helper.

Anonymous PagePreview on sandbox-for-codex, scp-wiki, and community returns the exact current text later. The implementation and public test cover own-line recognition, observed argument insensitivity, ASCII-case-insensitive module names, closing-body consumption, inline and raw ownership, and the RecentThreadsX lookalike boundary.

needs_source.missing_source: Comments, FrontForum, ForumCategory, ForumNewThread, and ForumThread still implement only their observed no-context branches. The anonymous baseline now establishes FrontForum populated and invalid-category output, Comments forward and reverse reads, and populated, empty, and missing category and thread reads, but it does not establish complete selection, pagination, actor, or mutation behavior.
needs_source.actionable_readonly_slice: Implement the observed FrontForum single-category limit, Comments page-thread read, and forum category and thread read models through public Deepwell seams without exposing mutation controls.

needs_source.missing_source: The category and thread routes render untranslated placeholders, /forum/start reaches the invalid-route fallback, and the observed read-only forum Ajax modules remain unsupported. The exact public URL, moduleName, parameter, success, no_category, no_thread, and no_page wire shapes are now sealed and actionable.
needs_source.actionable_readonly_slice: Implement ForumStartModule, ForumViewCategoryModule, ForumViewThreadModule, ForumViewThreadPostsModule, ForumCommentsListModule, and ForumRecentPostsListModule read paths plus their observed public routes. Keep all write modules unsupported.

candidate_required.requires: Run all three public Deepwell tests against the exact merged candidate. Bind each receipt to the anonymous request actor and fixture identities.
Run the focused Ajax connector Node test and one exact-candidate HTTP request. Confirm that unsupported forum modules cannot reach ListPages, page creation, or page-discussion mutation.

Run recent_threads_matches_live_placeholder_and_owner_boundaries and the ten sealed RecentThreads cases against the exact merged candidate. Bind the receipt to source, FTML, lock, fixture, actor, and runtime identities.

blocked_evidence.missing: The sealed anonymous baseline does not define FrontForum feeds, offsets, multiple categories, custom templates, relative-link rewriting, all pagination boundaries, private visibility, deletion, or complete Comments and ForumNewThread states.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not recognize captured page data, treat one category as the general selector contract, or infer actor and mutation behavior from anonymous reads.

blocked_evidence.missing: Deepwell exposes no public forum-post or standalone-thread mutation endpoint with request actor, forum permission, validation, idempotency, and rate-limit rules. Framerail does not validate wikidot_token7 for forum actions.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not expose ForumPostService fixture methods, reuse anonymous page-discussion provisioning, or render a form that has no safe action.

blocked_evidence.missing: The HTTP and connector wire contract is sealed, but no browser evidence covers category changes, pagination, history, focus, failed requests, intermediate paint, and settled output on the exact candidate.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not claim browser parity from a final Ajax body or conceal loading and failure differences through normalization.

blocked_evidence.missing: No sealed anonymous, member, moderator, administrator, imported-user, deleted-user, post mutation, cache refresh, or concurrent request matrix exists.
blocked_evidence.forbidden_inference: Do not infer private visibility, deleted identity, action controls, or cache behavior from the anonymous read-only fixture.

observed_stale_or_coarse_statuses.audit_disposition: The exact no-context Comments module slice exists, but populated syntax, forms, actions, actors, and browser behavior remain open.

The exact current placeholder contract is source-ready and implemented, but it remains pending until central tests and an exact-candidate replay bind the ten sealed live cases to the delivered runtime.

ledger_reconciliation.rule: Do not mark a forum feature implemented or close its issue until every source-ready row has an exact candidate receipt, every needs-source row is implemented through a public seam, and every blocked-evidence row is resolved by authoritative evidence and matching local authority.

corpus_pinned_literals.forum_result: The scanner reported no finding in forum_mini.rs or forum_modules.rs. It reported short notices for forum module names, which do not fail the strict gate.

closure_rule: This lane does not close either issue. RecentThreads is source-ready but still needs central Rust validation and an exact-candidate receipt. The populated forum and dedicated route and Ajax rows remain actionable source work with explicit residual evidence blockers. Mutation, actor, and browser lifecycle rows remain unimplemented until authoritative evidence and matching local authority define a safe vertical slice.
